name: QQQ/BTC Donchian breakout rotation with cash fallback
author: Quantpedia research note
instruments: QQQ/IBIT or BTC-linked series and cash
entry_long: Hold first-priority asset with valid breakout; otherwise test second asset breakout
entry_short: No short leg; allocate cash when neither breaks out
exit: Reassess at each QQQ session close; switch to cash when neither asset breaks out
position_sizing: 100% allocated to selected asset or cash
filters: Equity-calendar alignment; two priority versions grouped
claimed_performance: Source claims historical risk-adjusted improvements; self-published backtest and sample selection caveats apply.
implementation_notes: Parameter lookbacks and priority variants grouped. Source uses BTC intraday quote aligned to QQQ close; beware survivorship and sample endpoint issues.
